subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N47 across all 6 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N47 is one of the most common diesel engines from this era that we work on — six model lines across the BMW range, with the 3 Series and 5 Series being the applications we see most frequently.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain components, bearings, and complete gasket set as standard on every rebuild, with the timing chain replacement being a particular focus given the rear-mounted design.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Timing chain failure is the most widely-reported issue for this engine, made more labour-intensive due to the chain's rear-mounted position. EGR valve and cooler failure are also documented as wear items.
